## Change
Describe the user-visible improvement and link any issue.

## Verification
List commands run and browser scenarios exercised. For hardware work, include exact VID/PID, connection/mode, and observed physical result. Mark unverified claims explicitly.

## Checklist
- [ ] No automatic writes during connection or draft editing
- [ ] No speculative reset, bootloader, or firmware commands
- [ ] No secrets, serial numbers, vendor binaries, or unrelated files
- [ ] Relevant regression checks pass
- [ ] Documentation and upstream attribution remain accurate
- [ ] UI changes checked in light/dark and narrow/desktop layouts, if applicable
